decisions.question: Who registers the panel as an ExtractionObserver of the RestExtractor?
decisions.context: In v3, ExtensionRestExtraction.hook() wires the observer. On main, the RestExtractionPanel constructor calls extractor.addObserver(this) itself. One of the two (diagram or code) has to give way.

options.label: Panel registers itself (as on main)
options.summary: The RestExtractionPanel constructor calls extractor.addObserver(this). hook() only creates the parts and hooks them into ZAP.

method.name: hook
method.description: panel only created when ZAP has a GUI

pros: Matches the code: no refactor needed
A panel is always subscribed once it exists, so it can't be forgotten
hook() stays a pure ZAP-wiring method
cons: Leaks 'this' from a constructor to an object that calls it on proxy threads
The panel decides its own subscription, which hides the dependency direction from the composition root

options.label: Extension wires it in hook() (as v3)
options.summary: hook() creates the panel, then calls extractor.addObserver(panel). The panel constructor does not subscribe itself.

method.name: hook
method.description: panel only created and subscribed when ZAP has a GUI

pros: All wiring lives in one composition root
The panel can be built in tests without subscribing
cons: The code on main must change
A second place that builds a panel could forget to subscribe it
